# awx_group (Resource)

Manages an AWX group through `/api/v2/groups/`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "awx_group" "example_group_vars" {
  name      = "group-vars"
  inventory = awx_inventory.inventory.id
  variables = jsonencode({
    "grp1" = "val1"
    "grp2" = "val2"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `inventory` (Number) Inventory
- `name` (String) Name of this group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of this group.
- `variables` (String) Group variables in JSON or YAML format.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Database ID for this group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# The import ID is <id>
import {
  to = awx_group.example
  id = "1"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is <id>
terraform import awx_group.example 1
```
